A city councilor is also a goalkeeper—and he is still playing official matches

Shuya Okazaki, number 31 and goalkeeper for Kamakura International FC, is also a sitting member of the Kamakura City Council. After winning his first council election in 2025, he continued working with the club and playing as a goalkeeper, including appearances in official matches in 2026. Japan's Local Autonomy Act places restrictions on certain concurrent offices and municipal contracting, but does not impose a blanket ban on private-sector work by local assembly members. Using public election records, club materials, match reports, statutes, and council publications, this essay examines how the unusual-looking combination of「city councilor + active GK」actually works.
